mission_title: Moonscape Lunar Landing Site Scientific Assessment

scientific_report_data.title: Moonscape Lunar Landing Site Scientific Assessment

illumination.time_period_evaluated: LRO LOLA multi-year draconic precession baseline (Barker et al. 2021)
illumination.thermal_caveat: Surface temperature is a thermal brightness measurement, not a direct optical sunlight fraction.

hazards.severity_assessment: Micro-relief clearance to be confirmed via terminal optical descent sensors.
hazards.calibration_notice: Sub-meter boulders (< 5m) cannot be resolved from regional LOLA DEM without high-resolution NAC imagery.

factor_breakdown.description: Critical lander tipping stability metric. Slopes below 5 deg are ideal.
Solar energy generation potential and thermal environment stability.
Elevation above lunar reference datum (1737.4 km sphere).

positive_factors: High cumulative solar illumination (86.4%) supports long-duration surface power
Favorable topographic slope profile (6.8 deg) within nominal landing envelope
risk_factors: Low grazing solar elevation angles (< 2°) produce dynamic elongated shadows across terrain depressions.
Terminal hazard detection and avoidance (HDA) required to detect sub-pixel boulders during final descent.

data_sources.dataset_name: NASA PGDA Product 78 (LOLA 5m/pixel Candidate Site DEM)

methodology.topographic_slope: Horn (1981) 3x3 finite-difference convolution operator accounting for physical pixel spacing.
methodology.surface_roughness: Root-Mean-Square (RMS) height residual relative to moving local mean filter (15m baseline).
methodology.solar_illumination: JPL DE421 analytical solar ephemeris combined with multi-year LOLA draconic precession ground truth.
methodology.multi_criteria_scoring: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA v2.0-phase6) with non-redistributed missing factor penalty.

uncertainty.interpolation_uncertainty: Bilinear surface interpolation across polar stereographic grid (< 0.2m error).
uncertainty.hazard_scale_uncertainty: Features smaller than DEM resolution cannot be verified without high-resolution optical NAC cameras.

limitations: PRELIMINARY SCREENING ONLY: Assessment does not constitute NASA flight safety certification or terrain clearance guarantee.
SPATIAL RESOLUTION CONSTRAINT: Regional DEM cannot resolve boulders smaller than ~10m; terminal descent HDA is required.
EPHEMERIS SENSITIVITY: Instantaneous illumination depends strictly on landing epoch and local lunar libration phase.
scientific_report_data.conclusion: Candidate site 'Candidate Lunar Landing Zone' exhibits favorable preliminary landing suitability (Score: 83.2/100, Category: Higher preliminary suitability). Favorable slope corridors and high illumination support long-duration surface missions. Recommended for high-resolution stereophotogrammetric trajectory modeling.
scientific_report_data.disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: Suitability evaluations and hazard predictions provided by Moonscape are preliminary engineering research models derived from orbital remote sensing measurements (NASA LRO LOLA/LROC). These outputs do NOT constitute certified landing safety clearance for lunar flight missions.
